$comment: U-160, first leaf of U-150: road-facing rock that closes every edge of the bent road from the accepted insertion (z84) to the south gate. Everything off the walking surface is solid from y5.5 (future basement rooms below stay open) to at least 2.2 m above the road, then to its side's crest. Construction specification sections 3.2, 5.1, 6.2 and the U-159/U-160 addenda. Cover, landmarks and shells are U-161; X ingress U-151; ridge, bays and C12 stairs U-140/U-141.
